_readme: Client capability profile — HUMAN-ATTESTED, never inferred by the system.
Copy to data/review/<slug>.partnering.json and fill in what the client attests.
Keys starting with '_' are comments and ignored by the loader.
THE DISTINCTION THAT MATTERS: a key you OMIT is UNSET (unconfirmed — the
related blocker checks degrade to N/A with a gap). A key you include as
EMPTY is an ATTESTATION (e.g. "certifications": [] attests NONE held).
Certifications must be from: 8(a), SDVOSB, WOSB, EDWOSB, HUBZone.
